status: PROPOSED — owner approval is merging the amendment PR; freeze completes when this file's SHA-256 at the merged commit is recorded per spec section 9
billing_context: runs execute under the owner's Claude subscription, not metered API billing; no dollar cap is enforced; dollar figures are list-rate-equivalent accounting only

baseline.description: pinned coding agent, fresh session, isolated worktree, subject Decision text and repository access only; output is evidence-only and never merges

ace_assisted.description: same agent, model, and base tool allowlist plus the shipped 1.1 Code Intelligence journey; production path through ordinary review and merge

pins.mcp_ace_arm: shipped eleven-tool ACE Code Intelligence surface only
pins.cost_enforcement: none — tokens and wall-clock are the caps
pins.cost_accounting: list-rate-equivalent USD from metered tokens at published list rates, reported only

pre_freeze_slices.policy: retrospective annotation only, marked retrospective:true, excluded from the preregistered comparative result; unannotated gaps are valid and reported (spec section 8.2)

subjects.registration: scope, acceptance criteria, repository heads, and answer key frozen before either arm runs

analysis.granularity: descriptive, per subject; no statistical claim
analysis.better: ACE arm improves a majority of primary measures and materially worsens none
analysis.worse: inverse of better; secondary savings never convert a worse quality result
analysis.negative_result_policy: valid outcome, ships in evidence, does not gate J1-J10

exploratory_if: configuration differs from frozen digest, including agent version drift
second rerun after the single permitted rerun

experience_capture.retrieval_shortcut_events: first-class: retrieved item identity, work replaced, cycle-time saved in wall-clock and tokens
experience_capture.curve_projection: per-subject per-slice time series derived from capture records; reporting artifact, does not alter the per-subject tally
experience_capture.prior_slice_provenance: material-use receipt refs of earlier-slice beliefs; required for a point to count as compounding evidence
experience_capture.retrospective_flag: false for preregistered runs; true only for pre-freeze slice annotations
